title: 第27章 吃个包子就遇到骗子？

第27章 吃个包子就遇到骗子？-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

升旗仪式结束后，广场上的人群渐渐散去。

顾承安准备找个地儿吃早餐。

不准备吃特色豆汁了。

不是不能喝，是没必要找罪受。

他沿着前门大街往南走了一段，找到一家街边包子店，门脸不大，里面坐了七八桌人，蒸笼的白气从后厨往外冒，还能闻到一股若有若无的肉香味。

“一笼鲜肉包，一碗白粥。”

“好嘞。”

他挑了个靠窗的位置坐下。包子端上来，皮薄馅大，咬一口汤汁直接在嘴里炸开。

就是这个味儿，地道。

隔壁桌坐了个中年男人，四十来岁，穿着pOlO，边吃边刷手机，音量不小。

顾承安想不注意都难。

“……各位家人们，今天咱聊一件事！”手机里传出一个中气十足的男声，“就是最近这个菜市场被取缔的事，你们都看到新闻了吧？说什么影响市容，说什么消防隐患——我就问一句，老百姓买个菜都不让了，这是谁的城市？”

顾承安咬着包子，眼睛没动，耳朵却竖起来了。

主播继续说：“政府说要建新的便民市场，在三公里以外！三公里！让那些六七十岁的老头老太太，腿脚都不利索，走三公里去买菜？我告诉你们，这就是形式主义！”

顾承安放下筷子。

不对啊。

他在基地的资料库里翻过类似案例的处置通报。

菜市场取缔这类事，通常会配套临时疏导点和过渡期措施。这个主播只说了“三公里以外”，但绝口不提过渡方案，也不提旧市场被取缔的真实原因，并且买菜也不一定得到菜市场啊，现在超市里不都有嘛。

选择性陈述事实，刻意放大矛盾面，隐去解决方案。

妥妥的带节奏手法。

“大哥，”顾承安转头看向邻座，“这主播叫什么？说得挺好的，我也瞅一瞅。”

中年男人抬头看了他一眼：“抖音主播真话哥，挺火的，几百万粉丝呢，专替老百姓说话。”

“是吗。”

顾承安掏出手机，打开抖音搜了一下“真话哥”。

头像是一个戴金链子的圆脸男人，四十上下，简介写着“敢说真话、不畏强权、草根发声人”。粉丝427万，作品三百多条，几乎每一条都是类似的套路——找一个民生热点，截取最刺激情绪的片段，配上慷慨激昂的解说，评论区一片叫好。

这会正在直播呢。

评论区很活跃，看到不少网友点赞，评论，刷礼物的！

After the flag-raising ceremony, the crowd in the square gradually dispersed.

Gu Chengan was going to find a place to have breakfast.

I’m not going to eat the special bean juice.

It’s not that you can’t drink it, it’s that there’s no need to suffer.

He walked south along Qianmen Street for a while and found a street bun shop. It had a small front door and seven or eight tables of people sitting inside. The white steam from the steamer came out from the back kitchen, and he could smell a faint aroma of meat.

"A basket of fresh meat buns and a bowl of white porridge."

"Okay."

He chose a seat by the window and sat down.The steamed buns are served with thin skin and large fillings. The soup bursts into your mouth when you take a bite.

This is the taste, authentic.

There was a middle-aged man sitting at the next table. He was in his forties, wearing a pOlO. He was browsing on his mobile phone while eating, and the volume was not low.

It was difficult for Gu Chengan not to pay attention.

"...Family members, let's talk about something today!" A manly male voice came from the mobile phone, "It's the recent ban on this vegetable market. Have you all seen the news? What about affecting the city appearance, talking about fire hazards - let me ask, if the people are not allowed to buy even a vegetable, whose city is this?"

Gu Chengan bit the bun without moving his eyes, but his ears stood up.

The anchor continued: "The government said it will build a new convenience market three kilometers away! Three kilometers! Let those old men and women in their 60s and 70s with weak legs and feet walk three kilometers to buy groceries? Let me tell you, this is formalism!"

Gu Chengan put down his chopsticks.

That's not right.

He looked through the disposal reports of similar cases in the base's database.

To ban such things in wet markets, temporary diversion points and transitional measures are usually provided.The anchor only said "three kilometers away", but never mentioned the transition plan or the real reason why the old market was banned. Moreover, you may not necessarily have to go to the wet market to buy food. Aren't they available in supermarkets now?

Selectively state facts, deliberately magnify contradictions, and hide solutions.

A proper rhythmic technique.

"Brother," Gu Chengan turned to look at his neighbor, "What's the name of this anchor? He's very good. I'll take a look too."

The middle-aged man raised his head and glanced at him: "TikTok anchor Zhenhua is quite popular. He has millions of fans. He only speaks for the common people."

"Really?"

Gu Chengan took out his mobile phone, opened Douyin and searched for "Brother Zhenhua".

The avatar is of a round-faced man wearing a gold chain, around forty, and the profile reads "Dare to tell the truth, not afraid of power, a grassroots voice."It has 4.27 million fans and more than 300 works. Almost every one of them follows a similar routine - find a hot spot for people's livelihood, intercept the most emotionally stimulating clips, and add impassioned explanations. The comment section is full of applause.

This will be live broadcast.

The comment area is very active, and I see many netizens giving likes, comments, and gifts!
